source_lines: for row in range(top, height, size):
for col in range(left, width, size):
out[row:row + size, col:col + size] = np.where(block == background, fill, block)
rationale: Red cells mark occupied 4-by-4 squares on a lattice anchored at the minimum red row and column. Fill each occupied square's background cells with magenta, preserving red cells and leaving empty squares unchanged.
